title.zh: 重新开办新怡诗夏省Sabani市镇Bitulok中学，并将其改设为国立农村学校，名称为Sabani Estate农村中学
title.en: An Act Reopening the Bitulok High School in the Municipality of Sabani, Province of Nueva Ecija, and Converting the Same into a National Rural School to be Known as the Sabani Estate Rural High School
title.orig: An Act Reopening the Bitulok High School in the Municipality of Sabani, Province of Nueva Ecija, and Converting the Same into a National Rural School to be Known as the Sabani Estate Rural High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1829_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Bitulok High School in the Municipality of Sabani, Province of Nueva Ecija, is reopened and converted into a national rural school to be known as the Sabani Estate Rural High School.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the construction of necessary buildings, operation and maintenance of the said school for the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred fifty-eight. Thereafter, the necessary sum for said purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
